io96b_mb_ctrl
struct
io96b_mb_ctrl

What the mailbox needs before it can address one IO96B.  io96b_mb_init() fills the IP type and instance id.  get_mem_width_info() fills the sizes.

num_mem_interface

How many interfaces on this IO96B have a non-zero IP type.

ip_type

IP type of each interface. Two entries.

ip_instance_id

Instance id of each interface. Two entries.

memory_size

Size of each interface, in bytes. Two entries.
